usCorridor.description: USD payout corridor for US recipients

usdcSupport.description: USDC (Circle mainnet issuer) accepted as input asset

institutionalCredibility.description: Known entity, documented API, regulatory standing

rankings.activationBlocker: MoneyGram Access requires business registration at partners.moneygram.com/access. API key needed for production SEP-24 sessions.
rankings.notes: Perfect match for Axiom. USDC issuer in toml (GA5ZSEJ...) is exactly Circle mainnet issuer. USD payout corridor. 95ms latency. MoneyGram Access is a documented program for Stellar anchoring. The SEP-10/24 endpoints are publicly accessible — initiation will succeed up to the interactive URL step without a formal partnership. Full production payout requires MoneyGram partnership.

rankings.activationBlocker: TESTNET ONLY — will not process real payments. Requires configuring adapter for testnet network passphrase. Use STELLAR_ACTIVE_ANCHOR=testanchor with networkId=testnet.
rankings.notes: Zero partnership barrier. Immediately usable for end-to-end flow testing without real funds. USDC issuer is testnet-only (GBBD47...), different from mainnet. Must run adapter in testnet mode.

rankings.activationBlocker: No USD payout corridor. Only Argentine Peso (ARS) and Peruvian Sol (PEN). Would need USDC→local currency swap on Stellar DEX before anchoring.
rankings.notes: Good for future LATAM expansion. Not suitable for primary US corridor use case.

rankings.activationBlocker: EURC only. No USDC or USD support. Euro corridor only.
rankings.notes: Valid anchor for European corridor. Reserve for future EUR payment integration.

rankings.activationBlocker: Transfer server on different domain (ultracapital.xyz). No public asset list. Unknown corridor support.
rankings.notes: Low credibility score due to limited public documentation and domain mismatch.

recommendation.rationale: MoneyGram scores 100/100. It is the only anchor that simultaneously offers SEP-24, USDC support with Circle's mainnet issuer, USD payout corridor, sub-100ms latency, and mainnet operation. MoneyGram Access endpoints are publicly accessible for dry-run testing. Full production payout requires MoneyGram partnership activation.
